name: signoz-aio
description: SigNoz is a self-hosted observability platform for traces, metrics, and logs. [center] [color=#ff8c00]JSONbored Verified AIO Template[/color] [/center] This Unraid AIO template packages the official SigNoz Docker stack into a single container with sensible defaults for a first deployment. It internally manages SigNoz, the SigNoz OTEL collector, ClickHouse, and ZooKeeper, so you do not need to translate the upstream multi-container compose stack yourself. Advanced users can also override the metadata database and ClickHouse endpoints with supported upstream-backed settings. All-In-One (AIO) Edition Install it, keep the defaults, and point your OpenTelemetry senders at the published OTLP ports. Advanced settings are available for power users, but they are intentionally limited to real upstream-backed options instead of speculative extras. Initial Setup: 1. Click Apply. 2. Wait for first startup to complete. This image boots multiple internal services, so the first run is heavier than a typical single-service container. 3. Open the WebUI on port 8080. 4. Send telemetry to OTLP gRPC on 4317 or OTLP HTTP on 4318. 5. Optional: enable the built-in local host agent and explicitly fill the advanced host/Docker path fields if you want this same Unraid machine to forward host metrics, Docker metrics, and Docker logs into SigNoz. Resource Note: ClickHouse makes SigNoz powerful, but also heavier on RAM, disk, and startup time than lighter AIO apps.

paths.name: AppData - SigNoz Root
paths.description: Single persistent root that stores ClickHouse data, ZooKeeper state, generated config, and SigNoz SQLite metadata by default.

paths.name: [Host Agent] Host Root Path
paths.description: Advanced optional host metrics mount. Leave blank unless enabling the local host agent. Set to / only if you want to mount the Unraid host root read-only for host metrics.

paths.name: [Host Agent] Docker Socket
paths.description: Advanced optional Docker metrics mount. Leave blank unless enabling Docker metrics for the local host agent. Setting this to /var/run/docker.sock grants Docker control access to this container.

paths.name: [Host Agent] Docker Container Logs Path
paths.description: Advanced optional Docker log mount. Leave blank unless enabling Docker log collection for the local host agent. Set to /var/lib/docker/containers to read local Docker JSON logs.

ports.name: SigNoz UI Port
ports.description: Main SigNoz UI and API port.

ports.name: OTLP gRPC Port
ports.description: OTLP gRPC ingest port for agents, SDKs, and collectors sending telemetry into SigNoz.

ports.name: OTLP HTTP Port
ports.description: OTLP HTTP ingest port for telemetry senders that use HTTP instead of gRPC.

variables.name: [Host Agent] Enable Local Host Agent
variables.description: Advanced. Set to true to let this same container also collect local host metrics, Docker metrics, Docker logs, or Prometheus targets after you explicitly configure the host mounts or targets below.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone.

variables.name: [AIO] Startup Wait Timeout Seconds
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum seconds the wrapper waits for SigNoz or ClickHouse readiness before failing with a clear startup error.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Version Banner Enabled
variables.description: Advanced. Shows the upstream SigNoz startup version banner.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Log Level
variables.description: Advanced. Log level for SigNoz internal instrumentation logs.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Tracing Enabled
variables.description: Advanced. Enables SigNoz self-tracing; only enable when you have a clear internal telemetry target.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Tracing OTLP Endpoint
variables.description: Advanced. OTLP endpoint used by SigNoz self-tracing when internal tracing is enabled.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Metrics Enabled
variables.description: Advanced. Enables SigNoz self-metrics.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Metrics Host
variables.description: Advanced. Internal Prometheus host used for SigNoz self-metrics. This port is not published by the Unraid template.

variables.name: [SigNoz] Internal Metrics Port
variables.description: Advanced. Internal Prometheus port used for SigNoz self-metrics. This port is not published by the Unraid template.

variables.name: [Access] External URL
variables.description: Advanced. Public SigNoz URL used in generated links when serving through a reverse proxy.

variables.name: [Access] Ingestion URL
variables.description: Advanced. Public ingestion endpoint URL if agents should advertise a different OTLP endpoint than the UI URL.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] Provider
variables.description: Advanced. Metadata database backend for organizations, users, dashboards, and settings. Leave at sqlite for the built-in self-contained install, or set to postgres to use an external PostgreSQL database.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] SQLite Path
variables.description: Advanced. SQLite file path for SigNoz metadata when the metadata DB provider is set to sqlite.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] SQLite Journal Mode
variables.description: Advanced. SQLite journal mode for the default metadata database.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] SQLite Busy Timeout
variables.description: Advanced. How long SQLite waits for metadata database locks before failing.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] SQLite Transaction Mode
variables.description: Advanced. SQLite transaction locking mode.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] Max Open Connections
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum open SQL metadata-store connections.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] Max Connection Lifetime
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum SQL metadata connection lifetime. Use 0s for no lifetime limit.

variables.name: [Metadata DB] PostgreSQL DSN
variables.description: Advanced. PostgreSQL connection string used when SIGNOZ_SQLSTORE_PROVIDER=postgres. Example: postgres://signoz:your_password@postgres:5432/signoz?sslmode=disable

variables.name: [Auth] Provision Root User
variables.description: Advanced. Set to true to provision a SigNoz root admin user on startup. This works with either SQLite or PostgreSQL metadata storage.

variables.name: [Auth] Root User Email
variables.description: Advanced. Root user email address used when root user provisioning is enabled.

variables.name: [Auth] Root User Password
variables.description: Advanced. Root user password used when root user provisioning is enabled.

variables.name: [Auth] Root User Org Name
variables.description: Advanced. Organization name for the provisioned root user.

variables.name: [Auth] Root User Org ID
variables.description: Advanced. Optional predetermined UUIDv7 for the root user's organization.

variables.name: [Auth] Invite Max Token Lifetime
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum lifetime for invitation tokens.

variables.name: [Auth] Allow Self Password Reset
variables.description: Advanced. Allows users to request their own password reset flow.

variables.name: [Auth] Reset Max Token Lifetime
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum lifetime for password reset tokens.

variables.name: Tokenizer JWT Secret
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank to auto-generate a persistent secret on first boot and save it under /appdata/config/generated.env.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Rotation Interval
variables.description: Advanced. Interval for SigNoz token rotation.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Rotation Grace Duration
variables.description: Advanced. Grace duration for previous token pairs after rotation.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Idle Lifetime
variables.description: Advanced. Idle session lifetime before reauthentication.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Max Lifetime
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum session lifetime before reauthentication.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Opaque GC Interval
variables.description: Advanced. Garbage collection interval for opaque session tokens.

variables.name: [Tokenizer] Max Tokens Per User
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum opaque tokens tracked per user when using opaque token internals.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Use External ClickHouse

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Base DSN
variables.description: Advanced. Base ClickHouse DSN used by SigNoz. Leave at the default for the bundled database, or point it at your external ClickHouse endpoint.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Cluster Name
variables.description: Advanced. ClickHouse cluster name used by the SigNoz server for telemetry-store queries. Leave at cluster for the bundled deployment.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Healthcheck URL
variables.description: Advanced. HTTP healthcheck URL used before SigNoz and the collector start. Change this when using external ClickHouse.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Max Open Connections
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum open ClickHouse connections used by SigNoz.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Max Idle Connections
variables.description: Advanced. Maximum idle ClickHouse connections used by SigNoz.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Dial Timeout
variables.description: Advanced. ClickHouse connection dial timeout.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Query Max Execution Time
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse max_execution_time query setting.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Query Max Execution Time Leaf
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse max_execution_time_leaf query setting.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Query Speed Check Delay
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse timeout_before_checking_execution_speed query setting.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Query Max Result Rows
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse max_result_rows query setting.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Query Max Bytes To Read
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse max_bytes_to_read query setting.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Ignored Data-Skipping Indices
variables.description: Advanced. Optional comma-separated ClickHouse data-skipping indices to ignore for SigNoz queries. Leave blank for the upstream default.

variables.name: [ClickHouse] Secondary Index Bulk Filtering
variables.description: Advanced. Optional ClickHouse secondary index bulk filtering setting. Leave blank for the upstream default.

variables.name: [Host Agent] Prometheus Targets
variables.description: Advanced. Optional comma-separated Prometheus scrape targets for the built-in local host agent, for example: node-exporter:9100,cadvisor:8080.

variables.name: [Host Agent] Prometheus Scrape Interval

variables.description: Advanced upstream collector option for ClickHouse trace exception grouping. Leave at false unless you intentionally want the alternate grouping behavior.

variables.name: [Collector] ClickHouse Base DSN Override

variables.name: [Collector] ClickHouse Timeout
variables.description: Advanced timeout used by the internal SigNoz collector for ClickHouse operations and migrations.

variables.name: [Collector] ClickHouse Cluster Name
variables.description: Advanced cluster name used by the SigNoz collector migrations. The official external ClickHouse setup requires the cluster name to remain cluster unless you know exactly what you are changing.

variables.name: [Collector] ClickHouse Replication Mode
variables.description: Advanced replication setting used by the SigNoz collector migrations.

variables.name: [Collector] Traces DSN
variables.description: Advanced. Optional collector DSN for traces database. Leave blank to derive from the base ClickHouse DSN.

variables.name: [Collector] Metrics DSN

variables.name: [Collector] Meter DSN
variables.description: Advanced. Optional collector DSN for SigNoz meter database. Leave blank to derive from the base ClickHouse DSN.

variables.name: [Collector] Metadata DSN
variables.description: Advanced. Optional collector DSN for telemetry metadata database. Leave blank to derive from the base ClickHouse DSN.

variables.name: [Collector] Batch Send Size
variables.description: Advanced. OTel collector batch send size for regular telemetry pipelines.

variables.name: [Collector] Batch Max Size
variables.description: Advanced. OTel collector maximum batch size for regular telemetry pipelines.

variables.name: [Collector] Batch Timeout

variables.name: [Collector] Meter Batch Timeout

variables.description: Advanced. Scrape interval for the collector's own Prometheus metrics.

variables.description: Advanced. Enables SigNoz internal pprof endpoint inside the container. The port is not published by default.
